patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.chiefComplaint: Left lower belly pain and fever
presentation.quote: I've had a steady, achy pain low on the left side of my belly for two days, and now a fever. I'm not really hungry and my bowels have been off. It's tender right there when I press.
presentation.triageNote: 58-year-old female with two days of steady left-lower abdominal pain, reduced appetite, and a change in bowel habits. She has localized tenderness and a temperature of 38.2 C, without vomiting or generalized guarding.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 3 is appropriate because this stable febrile localized abdominal presentation requires multiple resources including laboratory testing and CT imaging.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has two days of localized left-lower-quadrant pain, bowel change, reduced appetite, tenderness, and low-grade fever.
clinical.acuityReason: The absence of generalized guarding, vomiting, or instability is reassuring, but inflammatory complications must be excluded.
expectedResources: IV fluids, analgesia, and antiemetic medication
keyFindings: Two days of steady left-lower abdominal pain
teachingPoints: Generalized peritonitis, hypotension, obstruction, or toxic appearance would suggest perforation or another complication.
Imaging helps distinguish uncomplicated inflammation from abscess or perforation.

possibleDiagnoses: Colonic malignancy or other inflammatory process
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Laboratory and CT assessment would guide outpatient treatment versus admission and procedural or surgical consultation for complications.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, hand pressed to the lower-left belly, guarded
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 58-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: one hand pressed to the lower-left belly, guarding slightly. Expression: uncomfortable and tired. Clearly visible: a hand pressed to the lower-left abdomen. No text, no logos.
